title: PackEvidenceRecord
description: Standardized evidence record emitted by Pack Manager (Stage 3) for downstream consumption by Returns Manager (Stage 4) and Recovery Manager (Stage 5).

id.description: Unique identifier for the packaging verification record.

org_id.description: Tenant organization identifier enforcing strict row-level security boundaries.

unit_id.description: Canonical cross-pod join key (UNIT-0001 through UNIT-0100) joining Receiving, Prep, Pack, Returns, and Recovery.

capture_id.description: Reference identifier for the physical image capture event.

order_lines.description: Customer order expectations encoded in standard SKU:qty format separated by semicolons (e.g. 'SKU-BOTTLE-750:1;SKU-PUZZLE-500:2').

observed_in_box.description: Observed SKU counts reported by the visual verification pipeline in standard SKU:qty format.

checks.description: Orthogonal three-check decision breakdown enforcing the 'one home per check' rule.

all_items_present.description: Strictly evaluates item presence/identity: every ordered SKU must have count >= 1.

quantities_correct.description: Strictly evaluates piece count accuracy: verifies ordered SKU counts match expected counts exactly.

nothing_extra.description: Strictly evaluates absence of foreign objects or seller catalog decoys.

verdict.description: Operational packaging verdict. When status='pending', verdict is strictly null.

status.description: Operational execution status. 'pending' signals fail-open execution (line not blocked).

model.description: Vision model identifier and version invoked for the single inspection call.

model_latency_ms.description: End-to-end vision model invocation latency in milliseconds, including transport retries and local repair.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the open-box photograph proving record provenance.

created_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the verification was recorded.

overrides.description: Immutable append-only audit trail of human supervisor decisions.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason code for downstream automated claims.

reason.description: Plain-language operational explanation of the check verdict.

cause.description: Attribution of defect or uncertainty: 'occlusion' indicates physically hidden items; 'recognition' indicates vision confidence or defect.
